title: Freezing and unfreezing unicellular protists using Mr Frosty container

steps_raw.instruction: Collect your culture in 15 mL falcon tube and centrifuge at 1000 g for 5 minutes

steps_raw.title: Discard medium and resuspend in 10 % DMSO growing medium
steps_raw.instruction: Use growing medium according to your organism, in our case is marine broth. We usually make 10 mL final volume (1mL DMSO into 9mL growing medium).

steps_raw.title: Aliquot 1 mL of your culture into criogenic vials
Place your criovials into Mr Frosty containing 100% isopropanol
steps_raw.instruction: Nalgene® Mr. Frosty® Cryo 1°C Freezing Containers

steps_raw.title: Store Mr Frosty container at -80ºC for at least 4 h
steps_raw.instruction: We usually keep it for 24 hours
Move your criovials into a long-term storage container at -80ºC
Take your criovials out of -80ºC storage and place them into 35ºC water bath for 2-3 minutes When you see they start thawing take them out of the water bath, usually is after 2-3 minutes

steps_raw.title: Transfer into fresh growing medium
steps_raw.instruction: We usually have 1mL frozen culture, transfer this 1 mL into 7 mL fresh growing medium flask
Monitor surival rates within the next 24h
After 2-3 days unfreezing, pellet your cells and resuspend with fresh growing medium Centrifuge 1000 g for 5 minutes
